prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were overall overly optimistic, yet consistently underpredicted performance for major winning tests.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), choose path layouts (choose_path, layout), and new finish flows (finish, new_flow) proved helpful, driving significant winning tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) consistently generated negative metrics or guardrail rollbacks.
Finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), home new flows (home, new_flow), sign-in copy changes (sign_in, copy), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) consistently resulted in no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow/redesign, sign_in layout/new_flow/redesign), requiring at least 2 tests to confirm a pattern.

4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Accessories New Screen: Adds a new pet customization screen ('new_accessories') in the adoption flow to customize colors and starter accessories. 5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Habitat Preparation Progress Details: Renders real-time stage progress text and time estimates during background pet habitat rendering. (why: Mean waiting step time is 2336s; displaying clear stage progress reduces drop-off while pet habitat loads.)
